title: Yi oda akan lokaci, duba kowane bayarwa, kwatanta farashi na gaskiya

say: Yi oda akan lokaci, duba kowane bayarwa, kuma kwatanta farashi na gaskiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura na biyu na Sarkar Kaya da Raw Materials Sourcing: tsarawa, dubawa da tsadar kayan ku.
Yawancin kayan haja ba mai kawo kaya kadai ke haifar da su ba. Suna faruwa ne saboda an yi odar da latti.

say: Matsala da aka samu a bakin gate ta biya ku kiran waya. An samo shi bayan samarwa, yana kashe duka tsari.

say: Ma'anar sake tsarawa shine matakin hannun jari wanda ke gaya muku: oda yanzu. Kuna buƙatar lambobi uku. Amfani da kowace rana aiki. Lokacin jagora, daga sanya oda zuwa dubawa, haja mai amfani. Kuma haja mai aminci, ƙarin wanda ke rufe makonni mara kyau.
Misali, Amaka yana cika matsakaicin kwalabe 100 a rana, kuma bayarwa yana ɗaukar kwanaki 5 na aiki a matsakaici. Don haka buƙatun al'ada yayin lokacin jagorar shine kwalabe 500.
A kwanakin aiki ta cika 140, kuma bayarwa ya ɗauki kwanaki 8 mafi muni. Mafi muni shine kwalabe 1,120.
Safety stock shine bambanci: 620 kwalabe. Kusan naira 60 kowanne, wato naira 37,200 na tsabar kudi daure.
Matsayinta na sake tsarawa shine 500 da 620, wanda shine 1,120. Lokacin da adadinta ya kai 1,120, ta yi oda.
Yi amfani da umarni shida zuwa goma na ƙarshe don nemo lokacin jagora. Alkawarin mai kawo kaya na kwana biyu ba shine lokacin jagoran ku ba. Bayanan ku sune.

panel.heading: Nemo wurin sake tsarawa
panel.rule: Rubutun ku sun saita lokacin jagora, ba alkawarin mai kaya ba.

say: Kwatanta bayanin isar da odar ku. Sannan kirga ku auna akan ma'aunin ku. Jaka mai nauyin kilogiram 25 mai nauyin kilogiram 23.5 gajere ne da kashi 6%.

say: Ajiye da kyau. Sanya sabon haja a bayan tsohuwar, kuma yi amfani da kayan tare da kwanakin ƙarewa bisa tsarin kwanan wata. Ajiye buhuna akan pallets ko shelves, nesa da bango, don rage damshi da kwari.
Zafi da zafi suna lalata mai, sukari da gari. Ajiye sinadarai, kayan tsaftacewa da mai da kyau baya ga abinci ko kayan kwalliya. Kuma lakabi kowane akwati.

say: Don tunawa. Yi oda a wurin sake yin oda. Bincika kowane bayarwa kafin ya taɓa samarwa. Kwatanta farashi akan kowane naúrar mai amfani, ba farashin sitika ba. Ajiyayyen madadin yana ba ku ƙarfi.
Kuma idan mai kaya ba zato ba tsammani ya neme ku da ku biya a cikin wani asusu na daban, kira su akan lambar da kuka riga kuka sani kafin biya.
